candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin get ear wahala. Caregiver talk say ear dey discharge for pikin, and di discharge don last for 14 days. I see pus dey comot from di ear. Di pikin no dey complain ear pain. I check, swelling wey dey pain behind ear no dey. Di pikin no get cough or any wahala to breathe. Di pikin no get diarrhoea. Di pikin no get fever. Di pikin never dey convulse and e no dey convulse now. Di pikin no dey weak or dey unconscious. Di pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Di pikin no dey vomit everything.
